name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. '13' is the chapter id (domain ID range 01-30, semantically meaningful and must be preserved -- not address residue); 'init' is the descriptor for a per-chapter init handler. Confirmed as the chapter-13 slot of data_fd2_chapter_init_handler_table (xref from table entry @ 0x51da1; the table dword at that address is 0x3346b). No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Chapter 13 (哈斯米爾之戰) init handler; the smallest chapter init (17 bytes): re-inits battle state, plays one dialog page, and pans the camera to char 0.
logic_summary: Watcom stack-probe __CHK(0x28) (frame check, not source body), then three side-effect calls: fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter(); fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page 0, 0xa0000,0x140,0xcd,0x4c,0x4a,0x13,1); fd2_pan_cursor_to_char(0). No cutscene, no portrait load, no char init, no pan-and-window prelude, no battle_anim_phase reset, no clear-facing. In the binary, after the entry block it tail-JMPs (0x3346b: PUSH 0x28; CALL __CHK @0x33470; CALL fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter @0x205da; JMP 0x3344d) into the shared dialog chain 0x3344d -> 0x33206 -> 0x33140 (owned by chapters 12 / 07 / 05). 0x33470 (= entry+5, the CALL __CHK site) is itself an alt-entry that chapter_16_init and chapter_19_20_21_init_shared tail-JMP into after pushing their own frame-size arg. Dispatched via data_fd2_chapter_init_handler_table; 0 direct callers.

returns.semantics: No return value; pure side effects (battle-state init, dialog playback, camera pan).

comment_original_issue: Original src comment was accurate and detailed but had two issues: (1) non-ASCII em-dashes (U+2014) in three places, which violate the code-ASCII rule (em-dash is not a proper noun); (2) the Shared alt-entry note said 0x33470 is 'the fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter CALL onward', but per the disassembly 0x33470 is the CALL __CHK site (entry+5) -- init-battle-state is at 0x33475; chapters 16 / 19-21 push their own frame-size arg before entering at the CALL __CHK.
notes: Disassembly @0x3346b: PUSH 0x28 / CALL 0x36cd7 (__CHK) / CALL 0x205da (fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter) / JMP 0x3344d -- confirms 17-byte size and the documented tail-JMP. Dispatch confirmed: data table @0x51da1 holds 0x3346b. Chinese chapter/NPC proper nouns kept (allowed). Plate (label L_chapter_13_init_alt_5 @0x33470) is consistent with the src conclusion and was left unchanged.
